name: pulsoicon-angular
description: 9955 animated Angular icons, each with its own hand-written motion: a standalone <pulso-icon> component and svg[pulsoIcon] directive. The same icons, props and motion as pulsoicon-react.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ng-packagr -p ng-package.json -c tsconfig.lib.json && cp ../../LICENSE dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.exit(process.cwd().endsWith('dist') ? 0 : (console.error('Publish packages/angular/dist (the ng-packagr output), not packages/angular.'), 1))"

author: CityPulso
